$comment: The compliance fence (CTO ruling CR-23). A pull request that changes any protected path passes the `compliance-fence` check only if it carries an `agent:<handle>` label for one of the assigned agents AND two approval comments bound to its current head commit: the Chief Compliance Officer (`regulatory-affairs`) for compliance, then Karma (CTO) for engineering. The check reads this file from the base branch, never from the pull request, so a PR cannot loosen its own fence. Changing this file is itself fenced. Each approval is one line on its own, e.g. `## CCO approval at <40-hex head sha>: APPROVED (CR-<n>)` and `## Karma approval at <40-hex head sha>: APPROVED (CR-<n>)`. Procedure: compliance/README.md.
